caseName: California Retail Liquor Dealers Ass'n v. Midcal Aluminum, Inc.
caseNameFull: California Retail Liquor Dealers Assn. v. Midcal Aluminum, Inc.

opinions.text:
Ct. App. Cal., 3d App. Dist. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 824.] Motion of respondent Midcal Aluminum, Inc., for reconsideration of order of November 26, 1979 [ante, p. 961], granting divided argument denied. Further consideration of suggestion of mootness of respondent Midcal Aluminum, Inc., is deferred to hearing of case on the merits.

Mr. Justice Brennan took no part in the consideration or decision of these matters.
